notes.title: Bloodline Update
notes.content:
Hello, mortals!

[i]A new warrior has been unleashed from hell! [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/69ec53bb87eff946bdfd6f1da36d7dc2aca30feb.png[/img]
[b]Val the Darkseed[/b] has a complicated origin. In the countless experiments done by Mephistopheles to create a clone of the dethroned King of Hell, only one succeeded the horrid experiment, creating the "perfect warrior".

Bequeathed with Hellsbane by Mephistopheles, Val is a ruthless and wild fighter albeit still a newborn. As a melee fighter, Val's combat style revolves around closing gap and execute the enemy with lightning fast speed. 

Val's unique mechanic enables you to dash into an enemy by executing an attack, making it a perfect tool to dispatch with a Hellbreak or just simply slash them to nothingness!
Though compared to Arok, Val isn't the toughest cookie when it comes to tanking damage, so be wary of the unforgiving hell's army!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/a66deabbec8494c78530075b43132c513aee83ba.gif[/img]
[i]"except these imps"[/i]
 
Here's the patch note for our latest update:
[list]
[*] Added the 4th Warrior: Val, the Darkseed

[*] Val is a melee warrior who excels in closing gaps to slay enemies. Utilize his lightning flash speed to quickly dispatch any foes that stand before you! His explosive speed, combined with the power of Hellsbane, nothing would be able to stop Val's conquest to escape hell!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/680dd6b0fd4a0fa7f01dd6f6f4d714d1685f8cb5.png[/img]
In addition to that, we're also celebrating Toge's anniversary with our very own publisher sale! Don't forget to check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/5485678/sale/togesale?fbclid=IwAR10xIq0r6K7lscMZd4KG4BoW3miQnenX1F6G8aHTB9Q2bucGuKPlgsC7fw]Toge Production's Catalogue[/url] and grab those sweet deals!

Yours Truly,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif[/img]
Hell Renovation Committee

notes.title: Controller and Performance Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, mortals!

Thank you for playing Rising Hell and for all of your feedback! 
Recently, We've come across some various reports regarding issues to game performance and specific controller not being shown in-game.

Our newest update have addressed these issues. As for the specific controller to work, some tweak on your steam settings are needed to be done:
[list]
[*] Go to your Library
[*] Right click on the game and select Properties
[*] Open Controller tab
[*] Change the "Override For Rising Hell" to Disable Steam Input
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/1b00ff9ee511c7930d130832696387ba70f5feb5.gif[/img]

Lastly and not least, we have some small teaser in our [url=https://twitter.com/risinghellgame/status/1438159790065156096?s=20]Twitter[/url] for the upcoming new character, go check it out if you haven't!

Best regards,

Hell's Renovation Committee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif[/img]

One of the features that we added is a dynamic zoom option where you can adjust or disable the zooming effect (though it doesn't change in some places like boss fights} in-game!

More changes can be found on the full patch notes below:
[list]
[*] Added Dynamic Zoom settings in the Options menu
[*] Added Screen Effects settings in the Options menu
[*] Fixed sound effects stacking when multiple source appears at the same time
[*] When killed by Final Boss in Redemption Mode, player will now respawn in the Boss stage instead of the Trickster's Treasury.
[*] Fixed locked Talent Combo showing wrong descriptions
[/list]

We will still continue improving the game, so your feedbacks are very much welcome! Please don't be hesitant!

Best regards,

Hell's Renovation Committee.

notes.title: Rising Hell New Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Mortals!

Just a few weeks left before Rising Hell is fully released! Have you caught up with the recent comic? In case you haven't seen our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/657000/announcements/detail/3052853394246225827]previous post[/url], the comic can also be found on our various social media platforms!

Since the full version of Rising Hell will be released soon, we took this chance to look back and improve the game. This is true regarding some of the gauntlet challenges that seem close to impossible to complete. Various tweaks and fixes are deemed necessary so we hope that this will improve the overall feel of the game. Nonetheless, here are the few changes that have been made:
[list]
[*] New languages: French and Spanish (LatAm)
[*] Rebalanced various talent costs
[*] Added SFX when displaying pop-up screen

[*] Fixed a bug with Trickster Mask relic where talent names and descriptions are misplaced

[*] Fixed a bug with Shockwrath talent icon
[*] Fixed a bug with Weekly Dares mode where modifier descriptions in Pause menu are misplaced
[*] Fixed a bug where Controls settings aren't updated after the Default button is pressed
[*] Fixed a bug where toxin gas become invisible in Bloodlust 2 of Gauntlet mode

[*] Fixed a bug in Gauntlet mode where Achievements aren't unlocked if player pressed the Skip button

[/list]

Phew, that's quite a list! If you made it this far, don't forget to see our latest updates on [url=https://twitter.com/risinghellgame]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/toge]Discord[/url] for future announcements!

Regards,

notes.title: Approaching The Final Gates Of Hell!
notes.content:
Greetings Mortals!

First of all, we would like to apologize for the lack of communications and updates. 2020 was definitely a hell of a ride for a lot of us. Although we had to move around, delay, and push back a lot of updates, we still managed to deliver most of the contents in the roadmap we pushed at the beginning of last year.

But worry not! We are approaching the final gates! We are pushing to deliver the 1.0 release of Rising Hell really soon!

Here are what we are working on right now:
[list]
[*] [b]More contents for 1.0![/b] Including the final boss and endings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/b724f4e8bafcad772c68a6f266c68f3ac7315506.png[/img]
[i]who could it be!?[/i]

[*] [b]Tweaking and improving the balance of Talents, Relics, and Warriors![/b] We want the player to have freedom to explore as many builds as they like.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/b5315014d6ac9cf19e38109ec4db0219679df9e6.png[/img]
[i]for a balanced soul economy in hell![/i]

[*] [b]Overall game polish and bug fix![/b] We are continuously improving the game by squashing bugs and adding more polish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/24002e91787e3804917ceb23000576df23ad087d.gif[/img]
[i]some hell residents are unpredictable...[/i]

[*] [b]More languages![/b] We are working with our localization team to deliver more languages for the game, as well as improving existing languages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/5fe8a7508f7d05d593db7898a163ada5499853fd.png[/img]
[i]Hell's committee going worldwide![/i]

[*][b] Console ports![/b] More news on this later. 🔥🔥🔥
[/list]
Phew! Just a bit stretch more to our final target!

We also added some new changes in the [b]Public Beta[/b] branch, don't forget to change to the public beta branch if you want to try it out. Here's the full patch note:

[b]Sydna Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased overall damage
[*]Increased orb explosion radius
[/list]

[b]Talent Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lifegreed: Increases green soul drop rate by 25% (From 20%), cost changed to 100 (From 120)
[*]Wraithlord: Increases invincibility duration by 1 second after taking damage (From 2s), cost changed to 90 (From 120)
[*]Nethergain: Increases weapon energy capacity by 100% (From 50%), cost changed to 150 (From 115), changed to tier 2 (From 1)
[*]Corruptcore: Improves the duration of artifacts by 5 seconds (From 4s), cost changed from 110 (From 150)
[*]Vilehand: Killing an enemy has 50% chance to restore your artifact weapon energy (From 10%)
[*]Fortunemaker: Cost changed to 140 (From 190)
[*]Felblade: Increases your attack power by 1% for each 25 Red Souls you possess (From every 10 Red Souls), cost changed to 210 (From 170), changed to tier 3 (From 2)
[*]Bloodwrath: Increases attack damage by 20% for each 10% missing life (From 10% attack damage)
[*]Relicmaster: Increases 25% damage of all artifact weapon (20%)
[*]Ragingsoul: Whenever you take damage, increases your attack power by 50% for 10 seconds (From 25%)
[*]Hauntergaze: Cost changed to 230 (From 300)
[*]Painbringer: Collecting artifacts increases attack damage by 50% for 20 seconds (From 8s)
[*]Darkgreed: Increases Red Souls dropped by Artifact weapon, cost changed to 75 (From 130)
[*]Fallenblood: Changed to "Grants 10% chance to do critical damage.", cost changed to 180 (From 250)
[*]Overburn: Increases your attack damage by 50% for 20 seconds after an artifact weapon energy has been depleted (From 8s)
[*]Zeal: Cost changed to 280 (From 260)
[*]Reapkill: Killing 4 enemies within 7 seconds restores 4% life (From 5%)
[*]Soulstrike: Cost changed to 120 (From 100)
[*]Chaosgrip: Cost changed to 115 (From 150)
[*]Killthirst: Increases Attack damage by 2% for each current Combo amount (From 1%)
[*]Felforge: Increases attack damage by 20% (From 10%)
[*]Netherblaze: Cost changed to 150 (From 200)
[*]Chaosguard: Shield cooldown changed to 20s (From 15s)
[*]Darkstalker: Cost changed to 120 (From 170)
[*]Bloodeater: Cost changed to 190 (From 205)
[*]Atrocious: Every time you collect 100 souls, increase your attack damage by 2% (From 1%), cost changed to 110 (From 200)
[*]Redemption: Cost changed to 130 (From 210)
[*]Grimhand: Every time you collect 100 souls, temporarily increase your attack damage by 50% for 20 seconds (From 10s)
[*]Harmless: Cost changed to 235 (From 300), changed to tier 2 (From 3)
[*]Bloodclaw: Cost changed to 200 (From 270), changed to tier 2 (From 3)
[*]Devourclaw: Cost changed to 140 (From 245), changed to tier 1 (From 2)
[*]Netherhide: For each talent you have, decreases all damage taken by 2.5% (Max 20%) (From 2%)
[*]Soulsyphon: Cost changed to 200 (From 250)
[*]Blightrain: Cost changed to 250 (From 265)
[*]Philantrophic: For each talent you have, decreases the cost of Talents by 2.5% (Max 50%) (From 5%)
[/list]

[b]Relic Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Devilhoof: (-) Increases Spike trap damage by 25% (From 50%)
[*]Ethereal Cloak: (-) Decreases weapon energy capacity by 15% (From 30%)
[*]Hellbrawl Orb: now have (-) Decrease attack power by 5%
[*]Ashtaroth: now have (-) Decrease max life by 10%
[*]Netherwalker Mantle: (+) Enemy projectiles are 50% slower (From 20%)
[/list]

As always, thank you for your support and please send us your feedback on the Steam Discussion forums or our Discord server

Regards,

Hell's Renovation Committee.

notes.title: New Boss Stage Update!
notes.content:
Hello Mortals,

[b]The Boss stage update is here![/b]

Our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/657000/view/2921110422012986552]previous update[/url] on Public Beta branch is now available in the main branch!
Now prepare to struggle more as we introduce a scaling complexity in Boss Stage as you progress through the Agony level. If you're familiar with our [i]Godslayer[/i] in Gauntlet mode now you'll get to see it in Conquest Mode as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/df966dddee64917ad67d0550487fe5c0fa52e87d.gif[/img]

For full patch note:
[list]
[*] Fixed platform collision glitch on Vault of Avarice stage.
[*] Fixed Chaosguard talent effect, shield now appears on start of the stage
[*] Fixed issue on randomize function sometimes not working properly.
[*] Fixed talent combo name glitch where "Vigor" was misplaced by "Devourclaw"
[*] Fixed character movement command using keyboard.
[*] FIxed life restoration value of "Bloodeater" talent.
[*] Fixed some "Weekly Dares" modifier description text error.
[*] Increases the complexity of Boss arena as your Agony level increases.
[*] Fixed a bug where player still able to activate elevator or portal gate when pausing the game.
[*] Fixed bug on "Nethergift" talent where the life capacity increased as well.
[*] Fixed some platform placements on Vault of Avarice in Hollow Gutter stage.
[*] Fixed Succubus hug attack glitch.
[*] Fixed some wrong scores on the Leaderboard.
[*] Fixed bug where player got stucked on the corner of Hell Lieutenant stage.
[*] Fixed the effect of Weekly Dares modifier now also restores life as well as increasing max life capacity.
[/list] 

We're also currently on sale during the Steam Winter Sale, spread out the words to your friends who wishlisted and interested in playing our game!

We hope everyone is having a good holiday. Until we meet again next year mortals!
Sincerely,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hell's Redemption update!
notes.content:
Hello, mortals!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/657000/view/5516306001410420569]The previous update[/url] in our public beta branch is now out! Aside from the update included in the last one, we added up to date achievements, and more will come soon.

In case you missed our last announcement, here's some interesting Mode and changes that you can try in our new update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/62b82f2773084e5be7e5c627276eef588df50eb6.gif[/img]
You can now play Conquest with [b]Redemption Mode[/b] option. By checking this option you'll get 3 chances (or lives) and continue from your current progress. Keep in mind that your soul and blight gain will be reduced in this mode, and your score won't be listed on the leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/f579732b4d6006cb99d02a31ff046ab4ba910cac.gif[/img]
Added 2 new challenges in gauntlet mode; [b]Madhell[/b] and [b]Deathrush[/b]. 

You'll be challenged with various obstacles and hazards in [b]Madhell[/b], but [i]a single mistake[/i] is all that it takes to kill you here so tread carefully. 
In [b]Deathrush[/b] time is your enemy! Climb your way as fast as possible and fight the archdemon before time runs out, the enemy here will also drop an item to extend your time limit. Be fast and be swift mortals!

Last but not least, bug fixes and more accessible options in the settings are included in this update. See our full list of the patch here:
[list]
[*] Added Achievements for completing Hellrisen, Madhell, and Deathrush missions in Gauntlet Mode
[*] Added new cinematic intro.
[*] New challenge : Deathrush. Race against time and slay the Archdemon before the time's out.
[*] New challenge : Madhell. Survive the torturing chambers of hell. Reach the way out, and become the untouchable.
[*] New Relic : Oblivion Bracer. Initially gives 200 red souls, start the game with 90% life.
[*] Added new Vault of Avarice stages.
[*] Added new difficulty : Redemption Mode: Gives 3 chances of Redemption, 1 is reduced when you die and you'll be resurrected.
[*] Increased Agony levels to 24.
[*] Fixed movement glitch on 3rd Archdemon (Dasael)
[*] Fixed glitch on 3rd Archdemon clone's attack movement.
[*] Fixed bug on Sydna's explosive spheres when attacking an Archdemon using Satanic weapon.
[*] Slain Archdemon now drops 100 red souls, while red souls bonus on boss reward screen are now decreased to 100.
[*] Fixed some bugs on Weekly Dares.

notes.title: Live from Hell: New Look for Arok and New Content Additions
notes.content:
Hello Mortals,

Not even a week since we pop into your notification, isn't it? 

We are here to announce that most of the stuff we've been working on is now live! Including Arok's new appearance, new talents and relics, and we now have a new talent reroll system as well.

You can find the details on the patch note below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/d9a46f48bb07d83950491c1468297c164279397f.gif[/img]

[b]Patch 0.9.1[/b]
[olist]
[*] Arok skin retouched. We've heard suggestions from players to revamp Arok's appearance.
[*] New Talent Reroll system. Spending Blight in the Talent room will refresh available talents into new ones.
[*] Zelos and Arok now have glowing effect on their character model to make them more distinguishable in the game. 

[*] 10 New Talents:
[list]
[*] Grimhand : Every time you collect 100 souls, temporarily increase your attack damage by 50% for 10 seconds
[*] Nethergift : Every time you gain a Talent, increase your max life by 2% (max 20%)
[*] Soultrade : Increases Red Souls gained from The Trickster's Treasury by 175%
[*] Harmless : Whenever you would take 10 or less damage from enemy, decrease it by 50%
[*] Bloodclaw : Every time you kill 10 enemies using Hellbreak, restore 2% Life
[*] Devourclaw : Every time you kill 10 enemies using Hellbreak, increase your Max Life by 1%
[*] Netherhide : For each Talent you have, decreases all damage taken by 2% (Max 20%)
[*] Soulsyphon : Whenever you spend Red Souls, restore 10% Life
[*] Blightrain : Gain 5 Blight when acquired
[*] Philantropic : For each Talent you have, decreases the cost of Talents by 5% (Max 50%)
[/list]
[*] 3 New relics
[list]
[*] Ifrit Halberd : (+) Increases attack damage when attacking in-air (-) Decreases damage of Hellbreak
[*] Trickster Mask: (+) Talents are free (-) Talent information are hidden and no portals to Trickster Treasury 
[*] Wing of Azrael : (+) Resurrects once upon death (-) Blights will not drop
[/list]

[*] The Maximum reward level now improved to level 40.
[*] 3rd realm (Citadel of The Faithless) is now added into challenge modes. 
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/olist]

That's about it ...not!

We have another announcement to make:
We are participating in [b]Indie Megabooth's Going Away (for Now) Sale![/b] So, tell all your fellow mortals that Rising Hell is getting a [b]10% discount[/b] starting from [b]May 5th – 12th, 2020 PST.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/ea11d55d3db5d390618f8fdd897844205730a91d.jpg[/img]

Wonder who's going to thrive in hell? You or them? 😈


...phew, that's a bunch of announcements to make in one post. Thank you for reading up to this point, and see you in hell!

Yours Truly,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif[/img]

Working in hell might not be as fun as you imagine. You might picture us torturing poor souls every day while laughing maniacally. But as part of the Hell Renovation Committee, we need to take care of what's doing good and bad in hell constantly.

[*] Killing Ifrit should unlock the achievement now

[*] When using a Relic which changes the default weapon into an Artifact Weapon, that Artifact Weapon will not be dropped by Artifact Monsters during the run

[/list]

Now go, continue your adventure in hell!
